objectives.name: Learn more about the agitated winds.
Speak with Missionary Jasaan at the entrance to Falaath Village
Use your Read Ley Line ability near the Thendal Grove Ley Line
Follow Aamelia and make your final stand
Carry Fillion Flamebreeze to safety while avoiding enemies
Check in on the Western Watchtower in the Shen'dar Highlands
